## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m ruff check .` is clean
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes; relevant focused tests cover the changed behavior
- [ ] Relevant training/algorithm changes include bounded learning checks; any
      additional `slow`, native-kernel, or accelerator checks and skips are reported
- [ ] Any component advertised as closed states its recipe boundary and ships the
      appropriate structural/runtime/full-step audit test — see [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Docstrings updated; user-facing changes noted in [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md)
